notes.title: The big 2023 patch!
notes.content:
> The dash has been completely reworked - the camera no longer snaps to xander's position.  Instead, the dashing is smooth and I-frames were added to the start of the dash animation to compensate for the fact that it's not instant anymore.

> The difficulty curve has been rebalanced - the beginning of the game no longer utterly destroys you.

> A mini map has been added to the pause screen.

> FPS fixes to certain windows OSs.

> Hitboxes for literally every attack in the game have been reworked to actually make sense.

> Auracapture beams home in on enemies like they will in myth caller.

> Minor glitches in relation to the catch arena have been fixed.

> The fishing minigame has been made less infuriating.

> Dialogue text changes to the fishing minigame and the mech lab to make it clearer what you're supposed to do in those areas.

> Sadomas has been un-nerfed to be as strong as it was in 2019.

notes.title: Ver.1.9 + Mobile Release!
notes.content:
Xander is marked for release on Google Play!  You can download/register here: 

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.Karatkuro.XUB

Changes in Ver.1.9:
[list]
[*] A shiny rate booster was added to the arena shop
[*] More enemy party setups were added to the arena!  Test your team against the ultimate arena morphers and get the shiny booster while you're at it!
[*]minor bug fixes
[/list]

As always, join the discord to have your voice heard on future updates!

notes.title: Patch 1.8
notes.content:
Based on feedback from the Discord's suggestions channel, the game just got these updates:

[list]
[*] Party members' health bars are displayed when switching monsters
[*] Storage/Fusion menus can be navigated with the mouse wheel
[*] The arena shows how many tokens you get after each round
[*] Storage/Fusion menus show monsters' elements
[*] Typo fixes 
[*] Crash fixes
[/list]

Join the discord to have your voice heard!
